name: Multi-Stage Attack Chain
description: A full kill-chain attack: spear-phishing initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, ransomware deployment, and simultaneous data exfiltration. Every phase must be detected and responded to correctly.
objective: Detect and respond to each phase of the attack chain in real-time. Minimize data loss and system downtime while eradicating all attacker presence.

events.message: Targeted spear-phishing: email from 'CEO@company-corp.net' to hr_director with malicious Word macro attachment
Malicious VBA macro executed in WINWORD.EXE — spawned PowerShell stager
LSASS memory dump: sekurlsa::logonpasswords executed — domain credentials extracted
Pass-the-hash lateral movement: workstation-HR-01 -> dc-server-01 using domain admin hash
Ransomware deployed via GPO: domain-wide execution of encrypt.exe across all workstations
Simultaneous exfiltration: 15GB transfer from db-server-01 to 203.0.113.100:443

hints: This is a full kill-chain — each phase requires a different response
Stop lateral movement to DC first to prevent domain-wide ransomware
The attacker is exfiltrating simultaneously with the ransomware — prioritize the DB server
Check GPO for malicious policies deployed by the attacker
